drhp.business: Bharti Airtel provides high-speed 4G/5G mobile, Wi-Fi (FTTH and FWA), digital TV, and digital payments to retail consumers, while offering enterprises secure connectivity, cloud and data center services, cyber security, IoT, and cloud-based communication. The company operates in 15 countries across India and Africa, with additional presence in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka through associate entities, and its digital arm Xtelify empowers global telcos with AI-driven digital transformation.
drhp.expansion: Airtel continues to invest in building future-ready digital infrastructure across its core businesses, digital portfolio and emerging growth engines. Ongoing 5G expansion and accelerated fiber deployment are aligned to meet rising data demand and evolving customer requirements. The data centre business continues to scale, with plans to significantly expand capacity in line with rising demand for data localisation and digital infrastructure.
